newsitem.title: GERMANY: Altana drop as mkt speculation debunked.
newsitem.headline: Altana drop as mkt speculation debunked.

text.p: Shares in German chemicals and pharmaceuticals group Altana AG opened lower on Thursday, partly reversing recent sharp gains, after the company issued a statement countering market rumours it might be taken over.

Altana, reacting to a rise of as much as 10 percent in its shares on Wednesday, said there was no truth to speculation of a takeover and that rumours of an imminent new product launch in the U.S were premature.
The shares were down 35 marks, or just under two percent, at 1,745 marks by 0730 GMT, but were off an earlier low of 1,715 marks. The broad market was up 0.8 percent.

Altana said its Byk Gulden unit was expecting approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to start clinical trials for a new respiratory drug but that it would take several years for the drug to come on the market.
